newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain and soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain and soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf grain and soybean values were steady on Thursday in quiet dealings, several U.S. exporters said.

Wheat brokers said activity was subdued as the market waited for conclusive opinions on new crop wheat conditions. Harvest was progressing rapidly through Texas and combines were expected to roll this week or next in Louisiana, Arkansas and Oklahoma.
But reports on yields and quality were mixed with some locations saying the crops were the best in five years while others offered less optimistic accounts.
Corn and soybean trade was thin amid lackluster demand.
